landing.title: Lists of any shape — films, shopping, games, anything.
landing.text: Fields, constraints, sharing, moves between lists, ratings from anyone, and charts. Calm UI, including on a phone.
landing.featTitle: What other apps split into five products
landing.featFiltersText: Filter by status, tags, dates and ratings — like Airtable or Letterboxd, inside any list.
landing.featViewsText: Table, cards, board, timeline and a month calendar. Each view keeps its own layout.
landing.featBulkText: Add a row with Enter. Select many items and check, duplicate, export or delete them.
landing.featInsightsText: Completion, averages, overdue and upcoming dates on the list and on the home screen.
landing.featEditorText: Reorder, duplicate, defaults, unique values and hints for every field.
landing.featShareText: Visibility, proposals, friends, ratings and transfers stay in place — we only added more power.

auth.confirmEmail: Check your inbox and confirm the address, then log in.
auth.forgotSub: We will email you a link.
auth.forgotDone: If that inbox exists, the email is on its way.
auth.resetSub: Set a password for signing in.

lists.title: Lists
lists.emptyText: Build fields from scratch or start from a pack.

newList.title: New list
newList.lead: Build a list from scratch or start from a pack / template.
newList.customLead: Name the list and add columns. You choose each field’s type and limits.

explore.title: Public lists
explore.lead: What authors chose to share with everyone.
explore.empty: Nothing here yet — publish one of yours.
explore.author: author

friends.title: People
friends.hint: Friends can see lists set to “friends” and edit them if you allow it.
friends.hintEx: Search a username and send a request.

settings.title: Settings
settings.files: Uploads are checked for type, size, and contents on the server.
settings.filesEx: A JPEG poster under 2 MB is fine. SVG, HTML and .exe are not.
settings.profileLink: Name and avatar live in Profile. Sharing is configured on each list.
settings.profileLinkAfter: . Sharing is configured on each list.
settings.publicNote: Public lists are visible to everyone. “Via proposals” lets others suggest edits without chaos.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: Delete public lists and block or unblock users.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete the public list “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
admin.blockConfirm: Block @{username}? They will not be able to sign in or change data.
admin.listNotPublic: List not found or it is not public
admin.hint: An administrator can only delete a public list and block a regular user.
admin.hintEx: Private lists stay out of this panel. The first administrator is granted in the database.

list.notFoundText: No access, or it was deleted.
list.emptyText: Add the first item or import CSV/JSON in settings.

viewEditor.hint: The owner picks which view types exist. Each view has a name, layout, and its own fields.
viewEditor.hintEx: “Cards 1” with a poster and rating badge. “Table” with only title and date.
viewEditor.name: View name
viewEditor.noCoverHint: Add an Image, File, or URL field to choose a cover.
viewEditor.displayNeedBounds: Set From or To for this field on the Fields tab.

settingsModal.title: List settings
settingsModal.name: Title
settingsModal.shareHint: Visibility and edit rights are separate.
settingsModal.shareEx: Public + “via proposals”: everyone can see, edits wait for your approval.
settingsModal.flowHint: A button copies the row to another list of yours and can remove it here.
settingsModal.ioHint: JSON keeps schema and rows. CSV is values only.
settingsModal.ioEx: Export Watched, edit in a spreadsheet, import back.

charts.hint: Each chart picks its own fields. The axis can be a date, status, year, or any other field.
charts.hintEx: Bars by genre, a line by year, a timeline by watch date.
charts.empty: Not enough data for this chart.
charts.needDate: Pick a field for the axis

schema.hint: Fields are the columns. You pick the type and limits.
schema.hintEx: Title text ≤ 200, Year integer 1888–2100, Ratings — collective score.
schema.name: Name
schema.descriptionHint: Shown under the field when someone adds or edits an item.

fields.pattern: Value does not match the pattern
fields.select: Pick a value from the list
fields.list: A list of values is expected
fields.fileType: This file type is not allowed
fields.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF or PDF. SVG and executables are rejected.
fields.nestedHint: A mini-table inside the item. Add subfields in the schema settings.
fields.multiHint: Anyone can rate — average and individual scores appear below.
fields.scanReject: File rejected by the security check

typeHint.text: Cap the length if you need to.
typeHint.number: Min and max are hard limits.
typeHint.multi_rating: Each viewer rates separately; the average is computed for you.
typeHint.image: Files are checked for type, size and contents.
typeHint.sublist: An item can contain a mini-table.
typeHint.sublistEx: a series season: episode, date, rating.

blank.title: Blank list
blank.description: Build the fields yourself — any type, any constraints.
blank.hint: Start with one text field “Title”, then add dates, ratings, files.
blank.example: A vinyl collection: artist, year, condition, cover photo.

movies_watched.title: Watched
movies_watched.description: Films and series you already watched. Anyone can rate.
movies_watched.hint: “Ratings” is collective: each viewer scores, the average is computed.
movies_watched.example: Dune, 2021, film, date 12.03.2024, scores 8 and 9 → average 8.5.

movies_watchlist.title: Watchlist
movies_watchlist.description: Queue of films and series. Move them to Watched or Dropped.
movies_watchlist.hint: Move buttons appear if you create the Cinema pack — it links three lists.
movies_watchlist.example: Tap “Watched” → the row moves, watch date is set to today.

movies_dropped.title: Dropped
movies_dropped.description: Titles you skipped or rejected — so they are not suggested again.
movies_dropped.hint: Add a reason: it explains why the watchlist got shorter.

games_done.title: Games finished
games_done.description: Catalogue of finished games with platform, hours and rating.
games_done.hint: Finish date feeds the “what we played which year” timeline.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.description: A grocery list with check-off. You can move rows to Bought.
shopping.hint: Enable check-off: ticking can stamp a date and move the row.

bought.title: Bought
bought.description: Purchase history with date and price.
bought.hint: Move items here from the shopping list with a button or automation.

later_shopping.title: Buy for an event
later_shopping.description: Deferred purchases — New Year, a birthday, a trip.
later_shopping.hint: “When” can be a date or a free-text event.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.description: Classic todo: check-off, priority, due date.
todo.hint: Checking off can stamp the completion date automatically.
todo.example: “Pay the internet bill” by Friday → tick → done date is today.

books.title: Books
books.description: Read and in-progress — with ratings and dates.
books.hint: The timeline uses the finish date. Collective ratings work like films.
books.example: The Master and Margarita, finished 01.06.2024, rating 10.

pack_cinema.title: Cinema
pack_cinema.description: Three linked lists: queue, watched, dropped. Move buttons are ready.
pack_cinema.hint: Creates three lists at once. Watchlist gets “Watched” and “Won’t watch”.

pack_groceries.title: Shopping
pack_groceries.description: Current list, bought items, and deferred holiday buys.
pack_groceries.hint: Check an item off — or tap a button to send it to Bought / New Year.

filters.title: Filters
filters.emptyText: Relax the filters or clear them to see items again.

insights.noneText: Add a few items to see completion, ratings and dates.
